fact: ATNOR's own site describes it as a public administrative establishment under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry that prepares and manages Chad's national standards, and records its technical committees adopting draft Chadian standards (NTD) on 31 July, 5 August (ten international quality-management standards as drafts) and 7 August 2026; none is on information technology or data.

ATNOR's page on the standardisation law says the law creates the national standardisation structures, including the Agence Tchadienne de Normalisation, charged with preparing, publishing and issuing Chadian standards and with adopting international standards as national ones; the page carries no date, so the 2014 published date is used.
